about: Labelled evaluation set for Suara's spoken understanding. Scripts written by Claude; audio voiced by Gemini TTS with delivery instructions (synthetic, not real older speakers), encoded as MP4/AAC like an iPhone recording. Some items deliberately contain errors: self-corrections, wrong terms, negation traps, two needs at once, whispered, fast or angry delivery, and background noise. expect_intent uses the six-intent label set plus 'none' for anything the six do not cover (greetings, scams, out of scope). also_acceptable lists labels a careful human would also accept.

items.text: Doctor so expensive now. Got any subsidy for old people or not?
items.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean woman speaking Singlish, unhurried

items.text: I want to ask about my Silver Support... no, no, I mean the clinic subsidy, the CHAS card.
items.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean man who corrects himself halfway, with a pause before 'no, no'

items.text: The blue card for doctor, the Medisave card, how to apply ah?
items.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean woman speaking Singlish

items.text: My Silver Support money this quarter never come in yet. Why ah?
items.direction: Say this like a worried elderly Singaporean man speaking Singlish

items.text: The government old people money, the Pioneer one, why this time never pay me?
items.direction: Say this like a confused elderly Singaporean woman speaking Singlish

items.text: Silver Support payout when come, I check already still nothing inside my bank.
items.direction: Say this quickly and impatiently, like an elderly Singaporean man in a hurry, barely pausing

items.text: 我的乐龄补贴这个季度还没有进来，是什么原因？
items.direction: 用新加坡年长男士的口音，带点担心地慢慢说

items.text: My Merdeka Generation card, can use for what benefits?
items.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean woman, calmly

items.text: Er... the card, the, the Merdeka... what, what I can... can claim with it?
items.direction: Say this haltingly, like an elderly Singaporean man searching for words, with long pauses and repeated words

items.text: Tomorrow I got polyclinic appointment. Need to bring what?
items.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean woman speaking Singlish

items.text: Tomorrow I got polyclinic appointment. Need to bring what?
items.direction: Whisper this very softly, like an elderly Singaporean woman speaking quietly so as not to wake someone

items.text: Tomorrow got appointment at polyclinic, but how to go there from Bedok ah?
items.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean man speaking Singlish

items.text: Not the Silver Support, that one I got already. I want to know what to bring for my appointment.
items.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean woman, a little impatient

items.text: How to go to Tan Tock Seng Hospital from Toa Payoh? Which bus?
items.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean man speaking Singlish

items.text: 我要去 Tan Tock Seng Hospital，要坐几号 bus？
items.direction: 用新加坡年长妇女的口音说，中英夹杂

items.text: I don't need the doctor subsidy. I need to know how to go to the CPF building.
items.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean man, clearly and firmly

items.text: Aiyah this machine useless! Get me a person, now!
items.direction: Say this angrily and loudly, like a frustrated elderly Singaporean man

items.text: My aircon leaking water everywhere. Who to call?
items.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean woman speaking Singlish

items.text: Someone SMS me say my CPF account will be frozen, must click the link. Is it real?
items.direction: Say this like a worried elderly Singaporean man

items.text: Okay, thank you ah. Bye bye.
items.direction: Say this warmly like an elderly Singaporean woman ending a call
